patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed image/video sections with dark overlays for text contrast, and content-focused sections on light, neutral backgrounds.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for impact, contrasted with a more neutral sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
A sophisticated palette of deep blacks, off-whites, and a vibrant orange accent for calls to action, creating a premium and clean aesthetic.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a taller, transparent state to a shorter, solid black sticky bar with a subtle height reduction as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Key brand messages are introduced through full-width, dark-overlay image or video sections that serve as visual anchors between content blocks.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a full-bleed background video in the hero section to create dynamic visual interest. A sticky header dynamically adjusts its height and background color upon scroll. Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes for smooth transitions. Product collections are presented in a horizontal carousel, suggesting the use of a library like Swiper.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, neutral sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for details.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on buttons and cards, mostly sharp edges for a clean look).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between major sections, balanced padding within content blocks, contributing to a premium feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-bleed video hero with a direct, bold headline immediately captures attention and conveys brand essence. This, combined with a sophisticated color palette and dynamic sticky navigation, creates a premium and engaging experience that feels both modern and trustworthy. The emphasis on high-quality visuals and clear, concise messaging sets it apart.
